title: Snag an Apple MacBook or Mac Mini with these Amazon Prime Big Deal Days deals that can save you up to $600
text:
Apple's entire range of computer products received an unfortunate price hike earlier in the year, an unavoidable side effect of the AI boom and scarcity of affordable memory modules. Now's a great opportunity to pick up a MacBook Air, MacBook Pro, or Mac Mini for a slightly reduced price, with savings up to $600 on some models.
Luckily for shoppers and deal hunters, we're in the beginning throes of Amazon's  Prime Big Deal Days sales week, and discounts are live on Amazon for a host of 2026/2025 Apple MacBook models and Mac Mini computers.
● Check out these Apple deals at Amazon
These deals may not be around for long. With prices ever rising on anything that hosts speedy memory or storage, the cost of Apple products is sure to rise again in the near future.  There's a good selection of configurations to suit your needs, with various amounts of either memory or storage offered in the different configurations.
Although not discounted, the Apple MacBook Neo is one of the best budget laptops that you can get your hands on. Definitely worth keeping your eye out for any future deals on the Neo as the sales continue throughout the week.
